title: Finite speed Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac processes and their applications in generative modeling
abstract: arXiv:2611.17625v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac (OU-K) process, where instead of a Brownian motion, a finite-speed Kac process defines the driving process. The OU-K process can be analyzed through a rescaled, time-inhomogeneous Kac process, characterized by a switching rate from the Kac part, and a convergence rate from the Ornstein-Uhlenbeck (OU) part. The law of this inhomogeneous Kac process describes the solution of a wave equation, the Euler-Poisson-Darboux (EPD) equation. For Kac switching rates being multiples of the OU convergence rate, we can explicitly derive this EPD solution via the sum of (the derivative of) two Legendre polynomials, restricted between two Dirac points representing the wave fronts. Using the framework of piecewise-deterministic Markov processes (PDMP), we describe the conditional velocity fields of the OU-K process via our polynomial-law-formula. This allows us to apply the OU-K process in a generative flow model. Sin

translated_title: 有限速度Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac过程及其在生成建模中的应用
translated_abstract: 我们研究了Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac（OU-K）过程，其中驱动过程由一个有限速度的Kac过程而非布朗运动来定义。OU-K过程可以通过一个重标度的、时变非齐次的Kac过程来分析，该过程由来自Kac部分的切换率和来自Ornstein-Uhlenbeck（OU）部分的收敛率来刻画。该非齐次Kac过程的分布描述了一个波动方程——Euler-Poisson-Darboux（EPD）方程的解。当Kac切换率是OU收敛率的整数倍时，我们可以通过两个勒让德多项式（或其导数）之和显式地推导出该EPD解，该解被限制在两个代表波前的Dirac点之间。利用分段确定性马尔可夫过程（PDMP）的框架，我们通过多项式分布公式描述了OU-K过程的条件速度场。这使得我们可以将OU-K过程应用于生成流模型中。
tldr: 本文提出有限速度的Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac（OU-K）过程，利用勒让德多项式显式求解Euler-Poisson-Darboux方程，并借助多项式分布公式刻画其条件速度场，从而成功将该过程应用于生成流模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces finite-speed Ornstein-Uhlenbeck-Kac processes, explicitly solves the Euler-Poisson-Darboux equation via sums of Legendre polynomials, characterizes their conditional velocity fields through a polynomial-law formula, and applies them to generative flow models.
